name: geo_perp_bisector_iff
statement: {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b p : V) : ‖p - a‖ = ‖p - b‖ ↔ inner ℝ (p - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (a + b)) (b - a) = 0
closed: ∀ {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b p : V), ‖p - a‖ = ‖p - b‖ ↔ inner ℝ (p - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (a + b)) (b - a) = 0
informal: p is equidistant from a and b iff p − midpoint(a,b) is orthogonal to b − a — ‖p−a‖² − ‖p−b‖² = 2⟨p − (a+b)/2, b − a⟩, and norms are nonnegative.
type: ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b p : V), ‖p - a‖ = ‖p - b‖ ↔ inner ℝ (p - (1 / 2) • (a + b)) (b - a) = 0
